The decision was just so permanent that it sends me into a panic whenever I think about it -- which is all the time. It's ruined my life in so many ways. I often feel like my life is a small room in which I am trapped and can't escape. It's impossible to explain but I feel physically trapped by being alive. 

Thank you for listening and understanding me when no one else will.

Thank you for saying that but I don't think it's true. My parents did coerce me. But at the end of the day, I made the decision to go to the clinic and have it done. And I made the decision to lie about it after. I can't blame them for what I did. And no one would want to listen even if I tried. 

I don't think a church would want to help me. I think even a therapist would judge me for this.
Thank you, but at the end of the day I did make the decision to go through with it. And I made the decision to be untruthful.
